query:
INSERT INTO email_outlook_sync_state (
            link_id,
            subscription_id,
            subscription_expires_at,
            delta_cursor
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
        ON CONFLICT (link_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            subscription_id = EXCLUDED.subscription_id,
            subscription_expires_at = EXCLUDED.subscription_expires_at,
            delta_cursor = EXCLUDED.delta_cursor,
            updated_at = NOW()
